title: Admin could call `adminSettleDebt` anytime without previous call `initiatingAdminSettleDebt`
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High, core functionality related to timelock would be bypassed  **Likelihood:** Low, since could be done by admin only accidentally or in case of malicious action  ## Description  The `adminSettleDebt` function is designed to allow the admin to settle debt after finishing timelock. The last one should be initiated during `initiatingAdminSettleDebt`. While `adminSettleDebt` successfully checks if timelock is ended, it fails to check if timelock was ever initiated, this way check at L713 would compare the current timestamp with the default value for `uint256` type - `0`,
